detail.title: Synthesizing Persistent Identity from Computational Boundaries
detail.summary: This research analyzes distinctions between memory retention and persistent synthetic identity using theoretical frameworks such as Michael Levin's computational boundary of a self.

detail.title: Computational Boundaries and Synthetic Identity
detail.summary: Exploration of how computational boundaries distinguish persistent identity from passive memory access.
detail.reason: Provides structured synthesis of collected literature regarding synthetic identity and Levin's computational boundary framework.
